uncited: It differs from static LOD methods by dynamically updating the mesh to achieve interactive frame rates, building on the bottom-up fusion principles of [Error-Based Model Generation (Bottom-Up Fusion)](1306-error-based-model-generation-bottom-up-fusion.md) by encoding all necessary simplification operations in advance.
**Inputs:** A high-resolution tetrahedral mesh representing the volume data.
**Outputs:** A dynamically updatable multi-triangulation structure allowing selective refinement to a target LOD.
The core structure is a **multi-triangulation**, which encodes the history of edge-collapse operations.
Each operation links a parent tetrahedron to its child tetrahedra, forming a hierarchy.
**Pre-computation of Simplification Path:** Perform a bottom-up simplification of the input tetrahedral mesh.
This involves iteratively collapsing edges to reduce the number of tetrahedra until a base mesh (lowest resolution) is reached.
This structure allows for the dynamic reconstruction of any intermediate LOD level by applying a subset of the recorded operations.
**Dynamic Refinement:** To render at a specific LOD, select a subset of edge-collapse operations to apply to the base mesh.
**Rendering:** Render the resulting tetrahedral mesh.
*   **Target LOD:** The desired level of detail, often determined by performance constraints or visual fidelity requirements.
*   **Selection Heuristics:** The criteria for choosing which edge collapses to apply.
*   **Dynamic Update Overhead:** The cost of dynamically updating the mesh must be low enough to maintain interactive frame rates.
*   **Visual Artifacts:** Improper selection of edge collapses may lead to visual artifacts or inconsistencies in the volume representation.
*   **Time Complexity:** Pre-computation of the multi-triangulation is offline.
Dynamic refinement time depends on the number of edge collapses applied and the efficiency of the selection heuristics.
*   **Memory Complexity:** Depends on the size of the base mesh and the storage required for the sequence of edge-collapse operations in the multi-triangulation.
Builds on established bottom-up simplification techniques.
Performance is dependent on the efficiency of the dynamic update mechanism.
*   **When to use:** When interactive rendering of large unstructured tetrahedral grids is required and hardware capabilities vary.
*   **When not to use:** When offline rendering is acceptable and static LOD is sufficient, or when the pre-computation cost is prohibitive.
It addresses the challenge of rendering large, complex tetrahedral meshes interactively by leveraging dynamic LOD techniques.
